top_signals.title: Automakers urge Congress to permanently ban Chinese connected vehicles in U.S.
top_signals.summary: Major automakers in the U.S. are urging Congress to ban the domestic sale, import and manufacturing of Chinese connected vehicles, hardware and software.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
